textual.limitations: The ASR contains apparent transcription errors in package names and prices; it does not establish any actual purchase, profit, or loss.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin packages by promising profit, millionaire-level wealth, token appreciation, and bonuses tied to recruiting and building a sales team. It explicitly describes network and multi-generation matching bonuses, requires package purchases to earn bonuses, and urges viewers to join while presenting the token as the next Bitcoin. These combined claims make the video an active recruitment and financial solicitation rather than a neutral cryptocurrency tutorial.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted earnings depend on a multi-person team structure: members sponsor recruits, receive business-volume bonuses from their sales team, and can earn matching bonuses across multiple generations. S05 is separately supported by claims that purchased or awarded tokens will increase in price and generate profit, while a paid earning-guidance cue is supported by paid education packages explicitly linked to learning how to trade for profit.
